note: Combat action sheets for the chapter bosses' own skills (docs/BOSS_SKILLS.md, src/foe-skills.js). Each is a 3x2 sheet drawn over the boss's identity and anchor (pipeline.py action <boss> <action>). frames: the six poses in order; loop: the six frames cycle (a hover). The body stays at the same spot and scale; combat moves the whole sprite (lunges, leaps, flight).

bite.frames: 1 ready pose; 2 the dragon crouches and pulls its head and neck back over its shoulders, jaws beginning to open; 3 the WHOLE body lunges forward toward the LEFT, front legs stepping out, head thrust forward with the jaws gaping as wide as possible, every fang showing (neck short and thick, not stretched); 4 the jaws slam shut hard, head low and forward to the left, the whole body leaning into the bite; 5 it pulls back, jaws closed, a little ember at the teeth; 6 back to the ready pose

tail.frames: 1 ready pose; 2 anticipation: the dragon turns its shoulders slightly away to the RIGHT and crouches, the long spiked tail lifting up behind it; 3 full wind-up, the weight loaded: the tail is raised HIGH and curled up over its back like a drawn whip, hind legs bent, chest low, head turned toward the LEFT target; 4 the swing: the hips twist toward the LEFT and the tail sweeps down and forward in a wide low arc in front of the body; 5 impact: the tail fully extended across the left at knee height, spikes leading, the whole body twisted into the blow; 6 follow-through: the tail has swept on past and curls back round in front of the legs, body still twisted, slowly settling

fly.frames: a hovering flight loop: the dragon is airborne with its legs tucked up under the body, head lowered and aimed down toward the LEFT with the jaws open (breathing fire), long tail hanging; the big wings beat through one full cycle: 1 wings fully raised, 2 wings sweeping down, 3 wings fully down, 4 wings rising, 5 wings half raised, 6 wings almost fully raised (flows back into 1). The body bobs very slightly with the beat

armor.frames: 1 ready pose; 2 the molten cracks on its chest, neck and legs glow brighter and it raises its head; 3 thick molten scale plates swell out of the cracks over its chest, shoulders and forelegs; 4 the plates cool and harden into heavy black obsidian scale armour with glowing lava seams over the chest, shoulders, forelegs, the back of the neck and a crested plate on the head; 5 fully armoured, it rears its head and chest in a roar; 6 fully armoured ready pose, the same stance as frame 1 but wearing the obsidian lava scale armour

attack_armored.frames: 1 ready pose like Image 1, mouth closed; 2 it rears its head up and back a little, jaws starting to open; 3 the head and chest thrust forward toward the LEFT with the jaws open in a snarl; 4 jaws gaping wide in a roaring snap toward the LEFT, head low and forward, front legs braced; 5 still snarling, head pulling back slightly; 6 back to the ready pose, mouth closed

1 ready pose; 2 the serpent draws its head back into an S curve, jaws opening; 3 the head strikes forward and low toward the LEFT, jaws gaping, the coiled body staying compact behind it; 4 the jaws snap shut, the head reaching left while the tail stays coiled tightly near the centre of the cell (nothing past the right edge); 5 the head draws back; 6 back to the ready pose
